## Decision
Adopt the Search & Web Intelligence chapter in **Commerce Amber** as the third homepage use-case world.
## Approved characteristics
- Google Search is the selected proof using a documented output example.
- The proof is explicitly labelled **not a live ranking**.
- SERP Analyze and URL to Text remain visibly separate next calls.
- Source URLs, result order and the evidence boundary remain visible.
- Generated imagery contains no UI, values, text, logos or product claims.
## Reserved review
Spacing, card proportions, wrapping, overflow, font loading, touch targets and responsive behavior will be normalized across the complete four-world sequence after the fourth chapter is designed.
## Boundary
This decision approves the design direction only. It does not authorize website implementation or any outward release.
